author: Simplilearn
description:
In 2026, Financial Analysts are earning strong, fast‑growing paychecks in both entry and senior roles. In India, fresher roles typically start around ₹3.7–6 LPA, with early‑career analysts moving into the ₹6–10 LPA range as they build skills in Excel, SQL, dashboards, and basic modeling. With 5–8 years of experience in areas like FP&A, banking, or fintech, many mid‑level analysts earn roughly ₹10–20 LPA, while top professionals and leads can cross ₹20 LPA, especially in metros and high‑margin industries.

In the US, entry‑level financial analysts usually see about $65k–$90k annually, mid‑career professionals commonly earn around $90k–$120k, and senior or specialized roles can push beyond $150k and into the $200k+ zone in investment, tech, or leadership positions. What really pushes you into the higher bands isn’t just years of experience it’s stacking core finance knowledge with strong data skills: financial modeling, forecasting, Excel + SQL, BI tools, and now AI/ML‑driven analytics
title: Financial Analyst Salary 2026: What You Can Really Earn from Fresher to Senior #simplilearn  #shorts

author: Simplilearn
description: In this video, we break down the real difference between a Software Developer and a Data Scientist in 2026. If you’re confused about which career path to choose, this quick comparison will help you understand roles, skills, salary potential, and growth opportunities. A Software Developer focuses on building applications, websites, and systems using programming languages like Java, Python, and JavaScript. They work on backend development, frontend development, APIs, and software architecture. On the other hand, a Data Scientist works with data, machine learning, statistics, and artificial intelligence to generate insights and build predictive models. Both careers are high paying, but the skill sets, daily tasks, and learning paths are very different. We also touch on salary trends in India and globally, required technical skills, and which role is better for beginners in tech. Watch till the end to decide which career suits your interests and long-term goals in the tech industry.
title: 🔥Software Developer vs Data Scientist #shorts #simplilearn

Want to start your career in Cybersecurity in 2026? 

Here are the Top 5 Cybersecurity Certifications you should consider to boost your career and salary. Begin with CompTIA Security+, the perfect certification for beginners to learn network security and risk management. Next, go for EC-Council CEH v13 (Certified Ethical Hacker) to master ethical hacking and penetration testing. For experienced professionals aiming for leadership roles, ISC2 CISSP is the gold standard in security management. If you want hands-on penetration testing skills, Offensive Security OSCP is highly respected worldwide. And for auditing and governance roles, ISACA CISA is a must-have certification.
